n6a62a8e834.headline: Exxon defends dividend after first annual loss in decades - The Boston Globe
n6a62a8e834.summary: ExxonMobil reported its first annual loss in decades due to a $19.3 billion writedown on U.S. natural gas fields and other assets, while defending its dividend payout.
n6a62a8e834.why: ExxonMobil is one of the world's largest oil and gas companies; its financial performance and capital allocation decisions influence energy markets and investor confidence in the sector.
n6a62a8e834.why_moved: Exxon's first annual loss in decades and large asset writedown raised concerns about the company's asset values and future profitability, pressuring its stock and energy sector sentiment.

nbdee5d2c78.headline: Google: Alphabet shares jump as ad, Cloud sales soar amid pandemic
nbdee5d2c78.summary: Alphabet's advertising business, including YouTube, accounted for 81% of its $56.9 billion in fourth quarter sales, driving a share price increase.
nbdee5d2c78.why: Alphabet is a leading global technology company whose advertising and cloud services significantly impact digital markets and investor sentiment.
